summary: A dual-channel arbitrary function generator controlled by an ESP32-S3 DevKit with an ILI9341 touch display and rotary encoder. Two AD9833 DDS sources are selected or gained via a TS5A23157 switch and OPA2810 amplifiers, then feed AD5452 multiplying DACs with OPA2810 output stages to produce CH1 and CH2 outputs on coaxial connectors, powered from a barrel jack through an isolated DC/DC converter and a 7805.

blocks.name: power-input
blocks.purpose: Barrel jack input with a push-button switch feeds the isolated DC/DC converter that makes the +12V rail.

blocks.name: 5v-regulator
blocks.purpose: Linear regulator derives +5V from +12V for the ESP32 dev kit 5V pin.

blocks.name: mcu-ui
blocks.purpose: ESP32-S3 dev kit runs the system, drives the TFT/touch display, reads the encoder, and controls the DDS, switch, and DACs over SPI-like buses.

blocks.name: dds-sources
blocks.purpose: Two AD9833 DDS chips generate the waveforms for channel 1 and channel 2.

blocks.name: waveform-select
blocks.purpose: Analog switch routes between DDS outputs and the resistor-divider paths into the input amplifiers.

blocks.name: ch1-gain-stage
blocks.purpose: Dual op-amp U4 conditions the CH1 function signal into the gained reference for the DAC.

blocks.name: ch2-gain-stage
blocks.purpose: Dual op-amp U11 conditions the CH2 function signal into the gained reference for the DAC.

blocks.name: ch1-dac-output
blocks.purpose: AD5452 multiplying DACs with op-amp I/V converters and output buffer generate the CH1 output.

blocks.name: ch2-dac-output
blocks.purpose: AD5452 multiplying DACs with op-amp I/V converters generate the CH2 signal path.

blocks.name: outputs
blocks.purpose: Coaxial and header connectors bring out the channel signals.

parts.U1: ESP32-S3 DevKitC controller providing the 3.3V rail, SPI-style clock/data, chip selects, display and encoder interfaces, and switch control.
parts.U2: TEC2-1221WI isolated DC/DC converter producing +12V from the switched input; Remote and -Vout are unused.
parts.U3: LM7805 regulator producing +5V from +12V for the ESP32 5V pin.
parts.DS1: ILI9341 TFT display with touch controller on shared SPI lines.
parts.SW2: Push switch that connects the barrel jack supply to the DC/DC input.
parts.SW1: Rotary encoder module for user input.
parts.SW3: TS5A23157 dual analog switch selecting between the DDS output and the divider path for each channel, controlled by GPIO21 and GPIO47.
parts.U6: AD9833 DDS generator for channel 1, framed by GPIO10, output to SW3 COM1.
parts.U7: AD9833 DDS generator for channel 2, framed by GPIO39, output to SW3 COM2.
parts.U4: OPA2810 dual op-amp: stage A with R5/R6 feedback and 0.3V bias, stage B with R9/R10 feedback producing CH1 gained_func used as the U8 VREF.
parts.U11: OPA2810 dual op-amp for CH2: stage A with R18/R19 and 0.3V bias, stage B with R21/R22 feedback producing CH2 gained_func for the U13 VREF.
parts.U8: AD5452 DAC for CH1 with VREF from gained_func, current output into U5 and RFB from the 10V_ref node.
parts.U9: AD5452 DAC with VREF from +10V and output into U10A, with RFB from U10A output.
parts.U13: AD5452 DAC for CH2 with VREF from gained_func, current output into U12A.
parts.U14: AD5452 DAC with VREF from +10V and output into U10B, with RFB from U10B output.
parts.U5: OPA2810 I/V converter for U8 and output driver for CH1.
parts.U10: OPA2810 dual I/V converter for U9 and U14.
parts.U12: OPA2810 I/V converter for U13 with an additional stage whose output goes through R20.
parts.R1: 50 ohm series output resistor between CH1 and the CH1 coaxial connector.
parts.R2: 50 ohm series resistor on the CH2 connector, but its CH2 side is unconnected.
parts.R3: Upper divider resistor from the NO1 switch contact into CH1 func_in.
parts.R4: Lower divider resistor to GND on CH1 func_in.
parts.R16: Upper divider resistor from the NO2 switch contact into CH2 func_in.
parts.R17: Lower divider resistor to GND on CH2 func_in.
parts.R5: Biases U4A inverting input from the +0.3V rail.
parts.R9: Lower leg of the U4B feedback divider to GND.
parts.R10: Feedback resistor of U4B from gained_func.
parts.R18: Biases U11A inverting input from the +0.3V rail.
parts.R21: Lower leg of the U11B feedback divider to GND.
parts.R22: Feedback resistor of U11B from gained_func.
parts.R11: Sums the U10A output into the CH1 10V_ref node.
parts.R13: Couples the CH1 10V_ref node to the CH1 output.
parts.R15: Couples U10B output into the CH2 10V_ref node.
parts.R20: Couples U12B output into the CH2 10V_ref node.
parts.C1: Bulk bypass capacitor on the +12V rail.
parts.J4: CH1 header in parallel with the CH1 coax.
parts.J5: CH2 header in parallel with the CH2 coax.

nets.+12V: Isolated DC/DC output powering the op-amps and the 7805.
nets.+12C: Switched barrel-jack supply feeding the DC/DC input.
nets.+3.3V: ESP32 3V3 output powering the display, encoder, DDS, DACs, and analog switch.
nets.+10V: Reference rail for the U9 and U14 VREF pins and pull-ups R12/R14.
nets.+0.3V: Bias rail for the inverting inputs of U4A and U11A.
nets.GNDA: Analog ground for the AD9833 AGND pins and ESP32 GND pins 43/44.
nets.GPIO11: Shared serial data line to the DDS chips and DACs.
nets.GPIO12: Shared serial clock to the DDS chips and DACs.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/gained_func: U4B output feeding the U8 VREF.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/gained_func: U11B output feeding the U13 VREF.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/10V_ref: Summing node for the CH1 DAC feedback and output stage.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/10V_ref: Summing node for the CH2 DAC feedback.
nets.CH1: U5 output through R1 to the CH1 connectors.
nets.Net-(J3-Pin_2): Barrel jack center pin feeding the power switch SW2.
